question: Does #12 (help-side blocking) raise NBA 20+ point share? Original scorecard showed +1.46 points on 10 seeds.
method: Season runs on 10 fresh NBA replication seeds (blkrep = main with #12, blkrepctrl = main before #12, d09c864), paired by seed; pooled with the original 10 scorecard seeds. Separately, dev/blocks/ab-margins.cjs played 8,000 fixed-matchup games per build in frozen leagues (rosters reset every game).
conclusion: No detectable effect: the original +1.46 did not replicate (replication -0.63); pooled +0.41 +/- 0.44. Fixed-matchup A/B shows no per-game margin change.
